## What happened?

Describe the problem and what you expected instead.

## Reproduction

List the smallest reliable steps to reproduce it.

## Environment

Include the CineDrive commit/version, deployment method, operating system, and browser/client when relevant.

## Additional context

Add sanitized logs or screenshots if useful. Do not include credentials, tokens, personal media, or other sensitive data. Report security vulnerabilities privately as described in `SECURITY.md`.
